summary: Exact Snapshot History Mirror Gate: persistence source correction may mirror into snapshots.json only when the snapshot timestamp exactly matches the current finviz snapshot. The prior same-session/same-bucket fallback was removed to prevent a correction run from mutating a different intrahour snapshot. Missing/unmatched timestamps now fail closed and are recorded as SKIPPED_NO_TARGET_TIMESTAMP or EXACT_TIMESTAMP_NOT_FOUND. No scoring or threshold retune; Final Snapshot Reconciliation remains mandatory.
